hints.title: Circular Graph Coloring
hints.text: For n sheets arranged in a ring colored with 3 colors where adjacent sheets differ, the problem reduces to the chromatic polynomial of a cycle structured search.

hints.title: Recurrence Relation
hints.text: Let P(n) be the number of valid colorings. The recurrence is P(n) = 2^n + 2 * (-1)^n.

hints.title: Modular Exponentiation
hints.text: Compute 2^n modulo 10^9 + 7 using fast modular exponentiation.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating all 3^n coloring assignments is exponential.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects chromatic polynomial derivation or linear state dynamic programming.
